title: Serialize And Deserialize Binary Tree
prompt: Design an algorithm to serialize and deserialize a binary tree. There is no restriction on how your serialization/deserialization algorithm should work. You just need to ensure that a binary tree can be serialized to a string and this string can be deserialized to the original tree structure.

examples.output: Serialized then deserialized gives same tree

hints: Preorder with null markers. Serialize: preorder, use 'N' or '#' for null. Deserialize: same order, build tree recursively.
Format: "1,2,N,N,3,4,N,N,5,N,N" - comma separated values, N for null.
Deserialize: split by comma, use an index/iterator. If value is N, return null. Else create node, recursively build left then right.
O(n) for both serialize and deserialize.
